deviations_from_card: (1) The first commit carries the core code and ReviewModeTest together (as tv-app A did): a tests-only commit would not compile, and each commit must be green. All 7 JVM cases were red before by compilation (unresolved moments/momentAfter/momentBefore/TransportPlan/PlayerAction/marks). (2) The GUARD case 6 could not be green before, because TransportPlan did not exist; it is declared a guard because it pins the arithmetic MainActivity already performed. (3) Write set shrank: PenSessionHost.kt and Timeline-adjacent files needed no change; PenConversation.kt (HeartbeatInput.marks + State copy) was the coupled file named by tv-app A's builder. (4) 'Sitting on a moment' is defined as t in [m - 40 ms, m + 500 ms): momentAfter skips moments <= t+40, momentBefore takes only moments with m+500 <= t (this is what makes momentBefore(5100) == null). The companion mirrors this rule in JS for the tick highlight, 'drawing k of n' and the disabled states; the TV still decides the jump. (5) Rate clamp now in Double (0.1..2.0) rather than Float; session.rate at the 0.1 bound is exactly 0.1 instead of 0.1f.toDouble(). (6) Case 8 in live-ui-test seeks away again after the jump so section 6 still exercises the D-pad return. (7) README also gets the live-ui-test count 27 -> 28 and a review-mode feature line.
notes: Case 8 (the device journey) is NOT run: no emulator here; live-ui-test.mjs only syntax-checked. The companion UI was checked headless (playwright-core from the scratchpad, chromium-1200) against a stubbed WebSocket: ticks at 25%/60% of a 20 s clip, 'drawing 1 of 2' at t=5000, prev/next disabled at the ends, both jump messages sent, no page errors; a state with no marks leaves the scrub bar bare. :core:test is now 61 tests (README updated). TransportPlan.plan takes durationMs per the card's signature but no verb uses it yet (seek+ is still unclamped at the end, as before). Health.kt (/health) does not expose marks; relay-stub's /health will, since it spreads the state. Remote keys unchanged; binding FF/RW to jump while paused is left for later. Side findings from the card (companion reconnect loop after a rejected PIN; /health leaking the PIN) remain open for stabilize.
